name: São Gonçalo do Amarante (Brazil)
description: Divided diagonally by a white band from the lower hoist to the upper fly into a blue upper hoist and a green lower fly, charged with seven yellow stars for the districts.
history: São Gonçalo do Amarante is a coastal municipality in the state of Ceará, Brazil, near Fortaleza. The flag is prescribed by Municipal Law No. 146 of 15 July 1975: blue for the sky, green for the sea, yellow for the sun and white for peace, with seven stars placed according to the geographic position of the seven districts.
